title: JavaBedrock+
description: If you love and appreciate the "Bedrock Edition" for its utilities and GUI, then this build will turn the "Java Edition" into bedrock, but without affecting or changing anything globally. This build includes convenient utilities such as emotes!
body:
# JavaBedrock+

# ✨ Turn Minecraft: Java Edition into Bedrock Edition Experience Minecraft Java Edition with the look, feel, and mechanics of Bedrock Edition. **JavaBedrock+** brings Bedrock-inspired visuals, interface, mechanics, controller support, character customization, and many quality-of-life improvements while preserving the familiar vanilla gameplay. --- # Features * Bedrock Edition interface * Built-in **Vibrant Visuals** * Advanced skin customization * Emotes * Full controller support * Bedrock mechanics * Modern optimization * Vanilla-friendly experience --- # 📦 Included * Eating animations * Bedrock GUI * Bedrock buttons * Bedrock bed textures * Smooth animations * Built-in **Vibrant Visuals** shaders * TAA+ rendering * Bedrock cursor * Smooth rendering * Emotes * Controller support * Bedrock cape physics * Harder Bedrock-style Wither * Classic combat mechanics * Leash villagers * Screenshot gallery * Multiplayer friends system * 3D fishing hook * Bedrock leather armor dyeing * Elytra closing animation * Bedrock block outline * Bedrock chat position * Bedrock player paper doll * Bedrock world creation tips * Bedrock inventory block outlines * Bedrock recipes * Fire spell for ignition * Fallen & dead tree generation * Remote block placement * Bone Meal can grow ferns * Item hints * Bedrock loading screen * Improved breathing animation * Bedrock water colors * Bedrock death screen * 3D Bedrock-style skins ...and much more! # Massive 1.2 update! * Postures for stances * Water animation from Bedrock * Water color from Bedrock * Skeleton shooting mechanics - the closer the player, the faster the skeleton shoots * Bedrock hotbar * Adjusting water bubbles like in Bedrock * Horse mechanics from Bedrock * Leaves change color if there is snow on them or if the leaves are placed in snowy biomes * Snow appears under trees in snowy biomes * The collision with the compost bin changes due to the items placed in the compost * Plants can be covered with snow. * Plants can be propagated by grinding bones * Redstone can be connected to pistons * The armor stand is equipped with a weapon by default * The cauldron fills naturally if there is liquid above it * The entity uses a shield if it is sneaking. * Living silkers can be colored. * Mushroom trees appear in swamps * Impaling Enchantment now deals damage to all mobs, not just water mobs, when they are in contact with water # Changes 1. The Eating Animation texture pack has been removed, as the eating animation in Bedrock is only in third-person mode, and the texture pack makes the animation in first-person mode. The modpack already has an eating animation! 2. Entity shadows have been fixed. 3. The language has been changed to English. 4. The menu mod has been removed. 5. Bedrock water has been fixed. 6. Excessive texture packs have been removed. --- # 💬 Feedback Have an idea, suggestion, or found a bug? Leave a comment on Modrinth or visit my YouTube channel: **https://www.youtube.com/@Dezzoff-y9b** I actively maintain JavaBedrock+ and always appreciate community feedback. If you enjoy the modpack, consider leaving a ❤️ and following the project! --- # 🚀 Ready to experience Bedrock in Java? Download **JavaBedrock+** and transform your Minecraft experience into something that feels just like Bedrock Edition.
